components.name: Primary button
components.description: The one filled action. Orange with near-black type.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #FF5F1F; color: #0A0A0A; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 4px; padding: 12px 18px; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FF5F1F; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #F5F5F5; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.16); border-radius: 4px; padding: 12px 18px; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #3E424F; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FF5F1F; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Status stamp
components.description: Job status. Light ink on a deep chip, square corners.
components.css: .ds-stamp { display: inline-flex; background: #3A2A22; color: #FFD0B8; border: 1px solid #8A5840; border-radius: 2px; padding: 2px 7px; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Owner rail
components.description: The owner bar. The current item is an orange underline.
components.html: TodayShopsMoneySettings
components.css: .ds-rail { display: flex; gap: 8px; background: #22262E; padding: 8px 12px 0; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-rail a { color: #B4B8C2; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 600; padding: 10px 12px; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; } .ds-rail a.is-on { color: #F5F5F5; border-bottom-color: #FF5F1F; }

components.name: Run totals
components.description: The Today counts, one strip instead of four cards.
components.css: .ds-totals { display: flex; margin: 0; background: #343843; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.16); border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: 0 10px 22px rgba(0,0,0,0.28); } .ds-totals div { padding: 10px 16px; } .ds-totals div + div { border-left: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); } .ds-totals dt { color: #B4B8C2; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-totals dd { margin: 2px 0 0; color: #F5F5F5; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 600; }

narrative.northStar: The target and the work order.
narrative.overview: CalibrationOS is the desk and the public front of a two-person ADAS crew in Gilbert. The visitor is a shop owner or a technician in a bay, under fluorescent light, with a van outside. The page should feel like the board they set up for a camera and the sheet they write the job on. Gunsteel is the ground. Orange is the safety vest and the only fill for a primary action. Headlines are the same stencil as the wordmark. Reading text is DM Sans. Clocks and money are mono. Status is five shop colors, not a UI kit.
keyCharacteristics: One display face, Saira Stencil One, including the CALIBRATION OS mark
Gunsteel surfaces with orange used as a fill, not as small gray-adjacent text
Ruled sheets (a rate line, a job row) instead of repeated admin cards
Status stamps with a light ink on a deep chip

rules.name: The Shop Status Rule
rules.body: Status never uses Tailwind blue, emerald, amber, or red.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Saira Stencil One is the only display face. Oswald is not loaded. DM Sans is the only text face. JetBrains Mono is for times, prices, and counts, not for labels.

dos: Do keep gunsteel, #FF5F1F, and the stencil wordmark.
Do draw status from the five shop colors.
Do use mono for a time, a price, or a count.
Do let a heading carry itself, without a kicker above it.
donts: Don't load Oswald or a second display family.
Don't draw a fake product window, fake logos, or invented stats.
Don't use a Tailwind blue, green, amber, or red for status.
Don't put a colored glow on a card.
